main_text.p: lerunt: inter quos etiam fuit honestus uir, doctor Pontanus.

Dixit ad me quidam multis notus, nullum esse uerbum in Scriptura, quod non posset ambiguè intelligi. Cui respondi: Si Scriptura est ambigua, multo magis scriptores, quorum inter-pretationibus tu uis ac-quiescere.

page.notes: The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The line "lerunt" is shown as printed, with the start of the word cut off. Show-through text in the right margin was ignored.
